decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day-patient program extends a core treatment area with visible positioning and fits sustained demand for flexible mental-health care, so management would likely retain it.
Outpatient sociotherapy closely matches the firm's community-based support model and complements established psychiatric and social-care services, making continuation likely.
Counseling for senior living is strongly aligned with the eldercare business and supports upstream client access to core services, so it would likely be kept.
The retail shop supports participation and sheltered-work outputs, but as a more peripheral sales channel with potentially limited scale it remains the most exposed product still on the market.
Meal delivery for seniors fits the firm's aging-in-place and practical support offer, but its newer status and more logistics-heavy economics give it a moderate withdrawal risk.
